authorization: Parent confirmed user no-board/offline-first instruction; no additional user permission required within mission stage 5 offline preparation.

incorporated_findings.S5-01: Orthogonal logical state and device quiescence/ownership fact. Before potentially submitting start, conservatively consume submitted identity and transfer ownership. Throw/unknown start/wait/abort and close/destructor do not release, rewrite or reuse BOs until independently confirmed terminal; terminal does not unpoison first version.
incorporated_findings.S5-02: Require result bytes exactly 384 before shared decoder; 0/383/385 rejected. Strict request frame length retained.
incorporated_findings.S5-03: Compare supplied uint64 identities directly; no implicit increment/wrap. Exhaustion of max ID/generation is explicit and Host reconstruction is not assumed to reset kernel state.

implementation_scope.allowed: Portable Host admission/lifecycle/result-validation policy plus dedicated deterministic event backend and real shared laya_io codec. First CPU build/execute may be prepared/run within bounds after actual API/source/TB/fixture inputs are frozen; independent review is required for acceptance.
implementation_scope.frozen_contract: 13 BO allocations, five model uploads totaling 448923648 B once per successful Session; seven workspace 192937984 B and IO32768 B clear/H2D each request; result D2H384 B; single InFlight; exact original indices/sizes, planned group_id mapping.
implementation_scope.init_boundary: If manifest/SHA/AUX validation remains outside portable core, explicit tested attestation/precondition and honest coverage statement are required. Select current fe067 generated package explicitly; no old default directory substitution.
implementation_scope.fixtures: Frozen actual request/result vectors with profile/tag/hash plus independently specified byte-order vectors; do not derive all expected bytes with codec under test.
implementation_scope.priorities: Attention, AXI diagnostics and Q8 implementation take precedence.

required_cpu_matrix: Two serial valid requests including B2 then B1; one initialization; exact event counts and byte extents; flags/reserved/unused lanes/finite checks.
Preflight tag/shape/offset/size/identity failures have no request mutation/sync/start and do not consume submitted identity.
Same-generation strict IDs, nondecreasing generation, maximum identities and exhaustion without wrapping; in-flight concurrent admission rejected.
Completed valid nonOK frame delivered as error, identity consumed, next new identity can run; no success marker.
Malformed/stale/wrong identity/shape/length/nonfinite result poisons after completed readback; diagnostic bytes never accepted delivery.
start-after-submit throw, wait throw, abort throw/nonterminal/unknown, close/destructor while uncertain; no forbidden release/reuse/new launch; explicit terminal only permits eventual cleanup.
Timeout then abort COMPLETED or ABORT still timeout and Poisoned; no retry/reload.
Initialization-attestation failure never Ready/start; result sync/read exceptions poison.

guards.heavy_serialization: This Laya workflow/agent tree only; unrelated server tasks are outside scope.
guards.evidence: Fresh logs, command/tool version, actual input hashes, guard and all process policies, full event/test results; preserve failed attempts.

not_released: XRT Session/CLI adapter or shared Host implementation extraction
CMake stubs or fake XRT dependencies
numeric-kernel simulation or Host performance claims
future_platform_requirements: One deployment record jointly binds xclbin SHA, four package tags, kernel/argument metadata, platform/shell and Host build.
Pinned real XRT compile/link, abort/wait/destructor ownership semantics and actual device quiescence/reset/retention evidence.
Separate cold initialization, resident preencoded request, Host-observed start/wait and later full-service timing; no fake-backend wall-time performance claim.
